constraints.description: Call opening date 2026-04-09; single submission deadline 2026-09-09.
Single-stage proposal submission and evaluation procedure.
The EU contribution takes the form of unit contributions (unit costs), not actual costs or a lump sum. Rates are per person-month. See unit_cost_rates.json.
constraints.source_section: WP PF section 2.1 Applicable unit contributions

constraints.description: Part B-1 page limit: Sections 1-3 together must not exceed 10 pages. Part B-2 (CV, capacity of participating organisations, ethics, security, MSCA Green Charter) has no page limit.

European Postdoctoral Fellowships: 12-24 months. Global Postdoctoral Fellowships: outgoing 12-24 months + mandatory 12-month return (24-36 months total). Optional non-academic placement adds up to 6 months.
Award criteria and weighting: Excellence 50%, Impact 30%, Quality and efficiency of the implementation 20%; each scored 0-5 (0.1 resolution); overall threshold 70/100.
A Career Development Plan and a Data Management Plan are mandatory deliverables (CDP at the beginning of the action; DMP by month 6).
Specific eligibility conditions apply to MSCA-PF in the research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme.
